 Follow What Is ‘The Mob’ on Hulu and Disney+? Cast, Host, & How to Watch
 Sabine Snyder Tue, October 27, 2026 at 5:45 PM UTC Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. With The Traitors: New Blood featuring civilian contestants instead of celebs, reality TV fans craving their next star-studded game of deception might want to check out Disney+ and Hulu's new reality series, The Mob .
 The mafia movie-inspired show comes from the same production company that gave us The Traitors . It brings together a dozen contestants , including familiar faces from The Real Housewives of New Jersey , Selling Sunset , The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives , The Sopranos and more, all vying for a chance to win some serious cash.
 So, how does the game work, who's in the cast, and where can you watch? Here's everything to know about The Mob .
 What Is The Mob About? 
 The Mob is a high-stakes reality competition series that sends 12 celebrities to a lavish Italian villa to compete for up to $250,000 in cash prizes.
 Advertisement Advertisement The series challenges contestants to complete mob-themed jobs to survive in the game. But the real power lies with the Don, a player chosen by the group who gets to decide who makes money and who gets whacked.
 Of course, being in charge presents its own risks. While the Don has absolute power, the other contestants can pledge their loyalty to a new leader, setting the stage for delicious betrayals. As these wiseguys fight to stay in the game, they'll have to figure out who they can trust — and when it's time to make a move — while trying to fill their own pockets.
 Disney
 Who Hosts The Mob ? 
 Emmy-nominated actress Parker Posey is pulling double duty on The Mob , serving as both host and executive producer. 
 With notable roles in Scream 3 , The White Lotus , You've Got Mail , and Dazed and Confused , Posey is no stranger to the spotlight — and surprise, surprise, she still knows how to work it. But looking fabulous while keeping the celebrity contestants on their toes? Just another day at the office for Posey.

 How to Watch The Mob Online:
 The Mob premiered with its first two episodes on Monday, October 26, 2026. New installments will be released weekly , with the season finale scheduled to drop on Monday, November 16. Viewers can stream the series on Disney+ and Hulu. 
 If you're new to Hulu, the basic (with ads) price is $11.99/month. If you want to upgrade to Hulu ad-free, it costs $18.99/month.
